description.value: Scott's Pizza 96 is a fast-food pizza outlet located in the Fraser Valley corridor of Metro Vancouver. The business operates under a Facebook-only web presence, limiting publicly available information. Touring cyclists in the area may find it a convenient roadside stop, but details about its layout and offerings could not be verified.

Additionally, the listed coordinates (49.18°N, 122.78°W) correspond to the Surrey/Langley area, not North Vancouver, raising a data-quality concern.
